title: musicofthings/panbiome-gut-ont
description: Oxford Nanopore gut microbiome workflow for human stool: QC, host depletion, species profiling, assembly, MAGs, resistance genes, function, diversity and reports.

input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Sequencing data, sample sheet and assay.

fastq.description: Basecalled reads: a folder of barcode folders (for example fastq_pass), a folder of FASTQ/BAM files, or one file.
fastq.help_text: Barcode folder names must match the 'barcode' column of the sample sheet. Unmapped BAM from Dorado is accepted; mapped BAM is not.

sample_sheet.description: CSV with columns barcode, alias, type and optional metadata.
sample_sheet.help_text: type is one of test_sample, positive_control, negative_control, no_template_control. Extra columns such as group, subject_id, collection_date are carried into reports.

assay.help_text: shotgun = whole-genome metagenome. 16s = full-length 16S amplicons profiled with Emu.

required_metadata.description: Comma-separated sample sheet columns that must be filled for every sample.

run_metadata.title: Flow cell and library
run_metadata.description: Details about this flow cell use (washed, second library).

pgx_barcodes.description: Barcodes used by the earlier PGx library on this flow cell.
pgx_barcodes.help_text: Any sample sheet barcode listed here is rejected, which prevents carryover from being mistaken for a gut sample.

pgx_regions.description: BED of PGx target regions in the host reference coordinates.
pgx_regions.help_text: Human reads falling in these regions are counted as likely carryover from the PGx library and flagged.

pore_count.description: Available pores at the first pore scan.
pore_count.help_text: Recorded in the report. A washed flow cell cannot repeat the Flow Cell Check, so use the pore scan value.

max_len.description: Maximum read length (bp). 0 means no limit.

adapters_fasta.description: Extra adapter or barcode sequences for the residual-adapter check.

host_depletion.title: Host depletion
host_depletion.description: Human reads are counted and discarded; they are never written to disk.

host_ref.description: Human reference as a minimap2 index (.mmi built with -x map-ont) or FASTA.
host_ref.help_text: T2T-CHM13v2.0 is recommended. A prebuilt .mmi saves several minutes per sample.

skip_host_depletion.help_text: Only for samples known to be free of human DNA.

host_min_aligned_frac.description: Fraction of a read that must align to the host to call it host.

taxonomy.title: Species profiling
taxonomy.description: Databases and thresholds. All shotgun databases must share one taxonomy (GTDB recommended).

kraken2_db.description: Kraken2 database folder (with Bracken files built for bracken_read_len).

kraken2_memory_mapping.description: Memory-map the Kraken2 database instead of loading it into RAM.

bracken_read_len.description: Read length the Bracken kmer distribution was built for.

bracken_threshold.description: Minimum reads for Bracken to re-estimate a species.

sylph_lineage_map.description: TSV mapping genome accession to GTDB lineage.
sylph_lineage_map.help_text: Build it with bin/make_sylph_lineage_map.py from the GTDB taxonomy files.

sylph_args.help_text: For noisy long reads consider --read-seq-id; check `sylph profile --help` for your version and tune in the pilot.

emu_db.description: Emu database folder (for assay 16s or both).

taxa_rule.description: Species call rule when two shotgun methods run.
taxa_rule.help_text: both keeps a species only when Kraken2/Bracken and sylph agree.

min_species_reads.description: Minimum Bracken reads to call a species.

taxa_synonyms.description: Optional TSV of name synonyms (alias then canonical name).

watchlist.help_text: Defaults to assets/gut_watchlist.tsv. Thresholds are placeholders until validated.

save_nonhost_reads.description: Keep the non-host reads (human reads are never kept).

assembly_annotation.title: Assembly and annotation
assembly_annotation.description: Long-read metagenome assembly, MAGs, resistance genes, plasmids and function.

skip_assembly.description: Skip assembly and everything downstream of it.

medaka_model.help_text: Must match the flow cell chemistry and basecaller version; verify with `medaka tools list_models`.

skip_binning.description: Skip binning and MAG quality control.

amr_min_cov.description: Minimum % coverage of the reference gene to report.

amr_min_id.description: Minimum % identity to the reference gene to report.

functional_targets.description: TSV of targeted gut functions (function, gene, ko).
functional_targets.help_text: Defaults to assets/functional_targets.tsv. The starter set must be curated before clinical use.

controls_qc.title: Controls and QC
controls_qc.description: Scheduled-control handling and per-sample thresholds. All values are placeholders until validated.

mock_expected.description: TSV of the mock community's expected composition (taxon, expected_rel_abundance).

control_summary.description: control_summary.json from the latest scheduled control run.
control_summary.help_text: Used when this run has no controls. Patient results are released only while it is PASS and fresh.

control_max_age_days.description: Maximum age of a referenced control run (days).

mock_max_bray.description: Maximum Bray-Curtis dissimilarity of the mock community.

mock_max_unexpected.description: Maximum abundance of taxa not in the mock community.

target_gb.description: Per-sample yield target after filtering (Gb); WARN below.

qc_min_reads.description: Minimum reads after filtering; FAIL below.

qc_min_mean_q.description: Minimum mean read quality; WARN below.

adapter_warn_pct.description: WARN when this % of reads still carry adapter.

host_warn_pct.description: WARN when this % of reads are human.

balance_ratio.description: WARN when a sample's yield is under this fraction of the run median.

group_col.description: Sample sheet column used to color plots and run PERMANOVA.

big_memory.description: Memory for the heaviest steps (databases, assembly).
